title: fix(scripts): name-fold loader gate rule 2 resolves the fixtures directory, not one spelling of it
body:
Fixes #24050

Clause-②: no. A repo gate's internal matcher; `scripts/` ships in no package, so nothing publishes (`skip-changeset`).

One file: `scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs` (+164 / -33). Branched from `main` at `6e43b7bc3f`; head `e1b31d6ba`.

## What changed

**Rule 2 resolves the guarded directory instead of matching one spelling of it.** It used to count a file only when its text held the repo-relative literal `packages/metadata/src/__fixtures__`. Now every path spelling on a line carrying `__fixtures__` is folded (case; a backslash read as `/`; `.`, `..` and `//` segments resolved) and read two ways:

- **as written:** the folded spelling holds the directory's four segments in a row. This covers a repo-relative path, `ROOT + '/packages/…'`, a URL, a vendored prefix, and a climb that comes back in;
- **from the file that holds it:** a relative spelling, joined to that file's own directory, lands on the directory or under it.

Segments are compared, never substrings. So `packages/services/service-metadata/src/__fixtures__` stays another package's directory, even though it contains the string `metadata/src/__fixtures__`. The literal substring check still runs first, unchanged, so rule 2 counts every file it counted at BASE.

- `referencesArtifact(text, relPath)` now takes the holding file's repo-relative path, and throws a `TypeError` without it. A caller that dropped it would otherwise lose every relative climb with no error. `scanTree` now computes `rel` before the call.
- Rule 3's "lies in the guarded directory" test (`isOtherPackageFixturePath`) now uses the same folded comparison (`liesInFixturesDir`), so the file has one definition of it. This changes no verdict. A token that rule 3 sets aside holds only word characters, `.`, `-` and `/`, and it sits between rule-3 delimiters, which are all rule-2 delimiters too. So it is exactly one rule-2 spelling, and if its folded form lies in the guarded directory, rule 2 has already answered `true`.
- `classifyReference`'s `self` test is unchanged. It judges the real path the walk returns, not a spelling.
- **The header's soundness sentence** (`:40`–`:51`, formerly `:41`–`:43`) now says what the scan checks:
  - the basename;
  - a path that resolves to the directory once folded and joined to the holding file's directory;
  - `__fixtures__` with `hotcrm` or `.artifact` on one line.

  It also says what the scan does not follow:
  - a computed path: a concatenation, a `.replace`, a variable, or a base other than the holding file's directory or the repo root;
  - a wildcard in a directory segment with no marker on its line.

  The rule-2 and rule-3 docblocks are updated to match.

## Self-test: 30 cases now 39; the matcher battery's floor goes from 20 to 29

There are nine new matcher cases. The existing cases now pass a holding file (`PROBE_FILE = 'packages/objectql/src/loader.ts'`), and their verdicts are unchanged. The roster and its floor (4) are unchanged.

| new case | expected | at BASE |
|---|---|---|
| relative climb `readdirSync(resolve(HERE, '../../../metadata/src/__fixtures__'))`, held by `packages/objectql/src/loaders/catalog.ts` | true | **false: red** |
| the same text, held by `packages/services/service-metadata/src/loaders/catalog.ts` (it lands in `packages/services/metadata/…`) | false | false |
| case variant `readdirSync('packages/Metadata/src/__fixtures__')` | true | **false: red** |
| backslash-separated spelling of the directory (source text with escaped backslashes) | true | **false: red** |
| `readdirSync('packages/services/service-metadata/src/__fixtures__')` | false | false |
| `` `packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/hotcrm-${kind}.artifact.json` `` | true | true |
| `glob('packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/hotcrm-?.artifact.json')` | true | true |
| `glob('packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/hotcrm-[ab].artifact.json')` | true | true |
| `glob('packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/x-{a,hotcrm}.artifact.json')` | true | true |

The "at BASE" column comes from feeding each new case's text and holding file to BASE's own `referencesArtifact` (the `6e43b7bc3f` blob, which ignores the file argument).

**Deviation from Acceptance 2, measured.** "Each must fail against today's matcher" holds for the relative climb and the case variant (and the backslash case). It is false for the four token-boundary cases: today's matcher already answers `true` for all four. Record `6225074650`'s probe measured the same ("the head handles all four").

Those four cases pin rule 3's path token running past `$`, `?`, `[` and `{`. Their red is shown by legs L6 to L9 below: each leg cuts the token at one of those characters, and only its own case goes red.

`{a,hotcrm}` sits in the middle of a name (`x-{a,hotcrm}`) on purpose. Directly after `__fixtures__/`, a cut at `{` leaves a token ending in `/`, and the literal-file test keeps such a token anyway, so the case would pin nothing. The record found the old `${name}` case pins nothing for the same reason.

## Ablations: each leg mutates the committed head, runs `--self-test`, then restores

Each leg goes through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode. Per leg, it checks on disk that the anchor count went from 1 to 0 and that the blob changed. It proves the restore by blob == HEAD (`5e94de5be75b`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`. An outer `trap` also restores the absolute path from HEAD. This is a root script, so there is no build or `dist/` leg.

| leg | mutation | red cases (of 39) |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | rule 2 reverted to BASE (literal substring only) | 3: relative climb, case variant, backslash |
| L2 | case fold off | 1: case variant |
| L3 | backslash fold off | 1: backslash |
| L4 | holder-relative reading deleted | 1: relative climb |
| L5 | segment run replaced by the bare substring `metadata/src/__fixtures__` | 2: the service-metadata `false` case, and the same climb from the other holder |
| L6 | path token cut at `$` | 1: the `${kind}` case |
| L7 | path token cut at `?` | 1: `hotcrm-?` |
| L8 | path token cut at `[` | 1: `hotcrm-[ab]` |
| L9 | path token cut at `{` | 1: `x-{a,hotcrm}` |

After the last leg: worktree blob `5e94de5be75b` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes, and `git status --porcelain` is empty.

## The gate over the real tree, against BASE

A scratch probe imported both blobs and ran them over the same walk: 10246 files, worktree at `e1b31d6ba`.

- **Rule 2 at BASE counts 1 file:** `scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs`.
- **Rule 2 now counts 4 files:** that one, plus three tests in `packages/metadata/src/`. Each names the directory by `join(HERE, '__fixtures__/…')`, resolved from its own directory:
  - `plugin-artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts`
  - `plugin-artifact-forward-conversion-retired-after.test.ts`
  - `plugin-unbound-form-predicate-roots.test.ts`

  All three were already references through rule 1 or rule 3.
- **References: 8 at BASE and 8 now, the same set** (6 test, 2 declared instrument, 0 loader). The gate reports no new reference on `main`.
- The gate prints: `has no non-test loader. 10246 file(s) scanned under packages, examples, apps, scripts, tools, .github; 8 reference(s): 6 test, 2 declared instrument, 0 loader.`
- Gate wall time on this box is about 1.5 s, against about 1.3 s at BASE.

## Verification, on head `e1b31d6ba`

- `node scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs --self-test` exits 0: `✓ check-position-name-fold-loaders self-test: 39 cases pass.` At BASE it exits 0 with 30 cases.
- `node scripts/check-position-name-fold-loaders.mjs` exits 0, with the line quoted above.
- Gate families were derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` with no paths: 32 commands, the same 32 the seat derived. All 32 ran locally and exited 0, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` included (`✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1884 cases pass`).
- `--ran` reconciliation: `32 derived, 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero; all 32 recorded an exit code).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the one file exits 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- The control-byte self-scan of the file found nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `..` guard is still undiscriminated.** No case discriminates rule 3's `..` guard, the first test in `isOtherPackageFixturePath`. The card's Measured section names it, but its Acceptance does not ask for a case. Now that rule 2 resolves climbs, a `..` token that lands in the guarded directory is rule 2's. The guard only keeps a token that normalises to another package's literal file, which is conservative and not load-bearing. Observation; carrier: none (承接者:无).
- **A wildcard directory segment with no marker is still unseen.** An example is `glob('packages/*/src/__fixtures__/*.json')`. The header now says so. Reach: no file under the scan roots spells such a glob. Not filed; carrier: none (承接者:无).
- **Rule 1 (the basename) is still case-sensitive.** The card excludes rule-1 changes. A case-variant basename joined to a variable base is a computed path, which the header already places outside. Observation; carrier: none (承接者:无).
